commit.message: KAFKA-19595 Added configuration validation option to Kafka server startup
KAFKA-19595 Added configuration validation option to Kafka server startup

files.patch:
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
 
 if [ $# -lt 1 ];
 then
-	echo "USAGE: $0 [-daemon] server.properties [--override property=value]*"
+	echo "USAGE: $0 [-daemon] server.properties [--check-config] [--override property=value]*"
 	exit 1
 fi
 base_dir=$(dirname $0)

@@ -89,6 +89,11 @@ Start the Kafka Server
     
     $ bin/kafka-server-start.sh config/server.properties
 
+Validate the Kafka server configurations
+
+
+    $ bin/kafka-server-start.sh config/server.properties --check-config
+
 ### Step 3: Prepare input topic and start Kafka producer
